info.title: tencent/hy-3d-3.6
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "tencent/hy-3d-3.6", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for tencent/hy-3d-3.6; use POST /v2/models/tencent/hy-3d-3.6/requests.

schema.description: The Comfy Router input schema for `tencent/hy-3d-3.6`, Tencent HY 3D 3.6 on TokenHub. It makes one 3D model from a text prompt, from one image, or from one front image (image_url) plus up to 7 extra views in multi_view_images. Send exactly one of prompt, image_url or image_base64. generate_type Normal gives a textured model and Geometry gives geometry only. The price depends on the input (text, one image or multi-view) and on generate_type.

ao_strength.description: Ambient occlusion strength, 0 to 1. Multi-view input only. Default 0.

bake_lighting.description: True keeps the lighting and shadows of the image. False removes them. Normal only. Default false.

enable_pbr.description: Return PBR texture results. Normal only. Default false.

face_strict_mode.description: True forces the exact target face count. Otherwise the count is adjusted by geometric error.

generate_type.description: Normal (textured model, default) or Geometry (geometry only). Case-sensitive.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded input image. Same formats and dimensions as image_url, up to 6 MB.

image_url.description: Input image URL. JPG, PNG, JPEG or WebP, 128 to 5000 px per side, under 10 MB. Required as the front view with multi_view_images.

model.description: The model to run. On the Comfy Router route this is supplied by the path (`/v2/models/tencent/{model}`) and may be omitted or sent as null; Router writes the path's model here after validation.

multi_view_images.description: Extra views of the subject, one image per view. Needs the front view in image_url.

prompt.description: Text-to-3D prompt, up to 1024 UTF-8 characters. Do not send with an image.

seam_less.description: True gives fewer seams. False keeps more detail. Normal only. Default false.

tex_fmt.description: Texture format. Normal only. Default jpeg.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for `tencent/hy-3d-3.6`: the terminal `POST /proxy/tencent/v1/api/3d/query` task document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is SUBMIT-AND-POLL. `POST /proxy/tencent/v1/api/3d/submit` answers a handle whose `id` is the task id, and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished task document.
The model files are in `data`, one entry per file format. Read `data[].url`, which is valid for 24 hours. `preview_image_url` is a preview image, not the asset. A `completed` task with no file URL is answered as a Comfy Router error. A `failed` task reaches the caller as a Comfy Router error.

TencentHunyuanImageError.description: Error details. Present only on a failed request

TencentHy3DQueryResponse.description: Response body of a Tencent HY 3D 3.6 query

data.description: Result files of a completed task

status.description: Task status. One of queued, in_progress, completed, failed

TencentHy3DResultFile.description: One result file of a completed task

type.description: File type, for example obj or glb

TencentHy3DViewImage.description: One extra view of the subject for multi-view input

view_image_url.description: Image URL for this view. JPG or PNG

view_type.description: The view. One of back, left, right, top, bottom, left_front, right_front. Each view at most once
